top_violation_types.typical_finding: Each staff member has documentation showing they received 2 doses measles/mumps vaccine, 1 dose rubella vaccine, 2 doses varicella vaccine and 1 dose Tdap

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.22(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All exits have clear legible and illuminated exit signs where required by DOB

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §131.09(f)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Walls and ceiling in commercial building Not properly constructed; Not maintained in good repair; unclean

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.14(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Teaching and supervisory staff trained in abuse/maltreatment identification and reporting. 2 hours of training received every 24 months. Training provided by OCFS approved trainer. New staff trained within 3 months of hire

top_violation_types.typical_finding: Person in charge of school prohibits staff from attending in absence of immunization documentation

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.13(a)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All staff who will have unsupervised contact with children has undergone child abuse and criminal justice screening and reference checks

top_violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.22(b)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Approved fire extinguishers provided in good working order and inspected
